inputs.text: A color still-life photograph of a brown ceramic espresso cup with a white interior on a matching reddish-brown saucer, placed on a warm wooden tabletop. A small amount of espresso with golden crema lies inside the cup. The cup handle points toward the lower left. A silver teaspoon rests on the right of the saucer, its handle extending behind the cup. Viewed from above at an oblique angle. Warm directional daylight, realistic cast shadows, glossy ceramic highlights, visible wood grain, metal reflections and fine coffee crema. Preserve the original subject, composition, viewing angle, cup and saucer shapes, materials, colors and lighting. Refine details, clean artifacts, improve edges and texture quality, and keep the photographic visual medium faithful to the source.
